descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. The Trainee will be part and responsible to support the logistics operational excellence team in Visp and it’s project leads within the execution of EO improvement/efficiency projects. The trainee will support from the definition phase to the improvement / implementation phase to optimize E2E Logistics processes at the visp site. The role of this person is to support and maintain structures (e.g. organization, decision, communication, documentation flows, in accordance with project management, in order to respect project management processes and increase project team efficiency. The hired candidate will be responsible for specific project tasks. These tasks will include developing metrics, tracking progress, prepare and orchestrate workshops and reporting to management. The purpose is to assist project leads and the logistics teams. They will also act as an active support for preparing regular reviews of the ongoing projects and highlight current issues/gaps. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture. An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. ​Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Responsible for internal coordination and support of project tasks in order to balance the effort of the overall Logistics and Supply Chain team.
• Participate and support in coordinating, issuing project related general and specific documents, reports and presentations.
• Co-ordination and follow up with cross-functional departments (Logistics, Plant Logistics, Supply Chain), tracking activities and deliverables (like list of deliverables, installation list and timely issue of deliverables).
• Responsible for the development of PowerBI dashboards.
• Organize internal workshops and support team members to establish agendas, meeting minutes, actions lists etc.
• Support daily management activities by providing assistance in monitoring and tracking important metrics on a daily and monthly basis. Aid in the implementation and tracking of planned activities. What we are looking for:
• Degree or ongoing studies in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field (B.Sc., M.Sc., Dipl. Ing., or equivalent).
• Initial knowledge or strong interest in chemical and/or pharmaceutical supply chains is a plus.
• Curiosity and openness to work across different disciplines.
• Motivated and proactive team player with a willingness to learn and contribute.
• Good knowledge of common IT tools; experience with SharePoint, Power BI, and Excel is an advantage.
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
• Flexible mindset with the ability to adapt to changing priorities, timelines, and tasks.
• Basic analytical and problem‑solving skills with a desire to develop them further.
• Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.
• Willingness to support administrative and organizational tasks as part of the learning role.
• Reliable and persistent in following up with partners to collect required information.
• Interest in process improvement methodologies; Lean Six Sigma knowledge or certification is a plus.
• Good command of English and German.
• First exposure to a cGMP environment is beneficial but not required. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. The QA Specialist (QA On The Floor) is responsible to the Associate Director, Head of QA Operations BioAtrium in joining a strong and innovative team that is perceived as a main contributor to the success of the large scale mammalian operations in our future BioAtrium site. A great candidate will have strong GMP mindset, have leadership capabilities, envisioning and driving teamwork, quality culture, and innovation with the goal of becoming a role model within Lonza. We are looking for someone comfortable working in a matrix organization, effective with cross-functional projects, someone who can conceptualize where we need to be, how to get there, and drive ideas to completion. The QA Specialist will within the QA Operations team as QA On The Floor, but will support other QA Ops teams (e.g. Clean Utilities and Environmental Monitoring, QA for QC and Electronic Batch Record Review) They will interact with the the other Operational teams at BioAtrium like Production, Engineering and Project Management. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Comply with, Develop, implement and monitor quality procedures to ensure compliance with GxP standards, corporate policies, Swissmedic, FDA and other regulatory body regulations and guidelines.
• Support all QA operations activities concerning SOP landscape, electronic batch records, training, deviation- / CAPA- and change control management
• Support all audits and inspections
• Identify and implement Lean / OPEX approaches in Quality and foster improvement projects
• Provide KPI reporting and execute action plans to address opportunities for improvement
• Work collaboratively with QA Operations and QA department colleagues What we are looking for:
• Academic degree in a Life Science discipline/ Engineering/ Quality Management or related field
• Experience in working on a regulated Medical device, Drug product or Drug Substance site
• Experience with Lean / Operational Excellence / Six Sigma
• GMP compliance expertise
• Ability to interface and communicate directly with customers and regulatory bodies
• Excellent written and oral communication to include accurate and legible documentation
• Ability to work on call and/or out of normal working hours on site
• Fluency in English is required, German language skills are an advantage About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. This role provides essential support to the Legal Department on corporate governance, commercial register filings, and administrative excellence. You will act as a key coordinator for all Swiss Lonza entities, ensuring legal compliance and operational efficiency while working closely with legal counsel and international stakeholders. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
• Benefits in Basel: https://bit.ly/3HZNGv2 What you will do:
• Manage all commercial register updates (entries, changes, and deletions) for Swiss Lonza entities, drafting resolutions and ensuring regulatory compliance.
• Support the administration of contracts throughout their lifecycle using the CLM tool (e.g. maintaining contract records, updating metadata, tracking deadlines, and coordinating review and signature processes including notarization as needed).
• Take ownership of the Legal Proceedings Report (LPR) three times a year, ensuring all data is accurate and submitted on schedule.
• Conduct in-depth research to assist the legal team in navigating complex corporate or commercial legal matters and routine legal inquiries.
• Act as a liaison between the legal department, international law firms, and notary offices to drive cross-border projects.
• Oversee the Basel legal team’s shared inbox, handle travel arrangements, process expenses, and manage vendor invoices and payments.
• Organize global retreats and events while maintaining an efficient archiving system for all critical legal documentation. What we are looking for:
• 5–10 years of experience in a Paralegal role, either within an in-house legal department or a private law practice.
• In-depth knowledge of legal terminology, corporate law principles, and the ability to analyze complex documents for accuracy.
• Advanced computer skills and experience managing digital signature platforms and financial processing tools.
• Business fluency in English and German is required; French proficiency is a significant advantage for managing Swiss entity filings.
• Ideally an Executive Assistant with legal experience, a Paralegal certificate, or a University degree in Law (BLaw/MLaw) or Business.

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated individuals working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our individuals own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. Communicate with manufacturing, QA, and customers. Represent QC in project teams. Make decisions independently. In a matrix organization, you collaborate with labs, program management, production, and quality assurance. What you'll do:
• Establishing and maintaining customer relationships.
• Preparing and supporting production campaigns.
• Processing change requests and deviations under GMP.
• Supporting customer audits and inspections by authorities.
• Calculating and monitoring QC costs in the project.
• Independent coordination, prioritization and scheduling of tasks. What we're looking for:
• PhD or equivalent experience in the Life Sciences (Biology, Biochemistry or Pharmaceutical Sciences).
• Experience in the GMP environment and in Quality Control is a plus
• Proficient use of common software applications (MS Office) is required. Knowledge of individual pharmaceutical/laboratory software (e.g., Documentum, LIMS, Trackwise) is a plus.
• You enjoy working with many people in many different business areas and you bring the necessary organizational and project management skills to handle demanding projects. Your communication style is characterized by integrity and assertiveness.
• Excellent communication skills in English is a must, communication skills in German is an advantage. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. Lonza is seeking a senior leader to head its Global Business Services Organization (GBSO) for Finance, with full accountability for delivering high-quality, standardized, and efficient finance services at enterprise scale. This role owns end-to-end global finance operations across Order-to-Cash, Source-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report, leading a 300+ person organization structured in global process towers. Operating within a multi-location shared services model across the UK, Costa Rica, and India, the role partners closely with the Lonza Capability Centre to ensure world-class service delivery, scalability, and operational excellence. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Finance, the GBSO acts as the global functional owner for Finance services, driving performance, governance, and continuous improvement across regions. Beyond core transactional finance, the role leads strategic value creation through global service towers, including Finance Legal Entity Representation, SAR Controlling, and a Finance Centre of Excellence covering SAP access, finance applications, master data governance, and corporate finance project delivery. A key mandate is to modernize finance operations through digitalization and AI, positioning Finance as a high-impact, future-ready global service organization. Key Responsibilities
• Set and execute the global Finance Shared Services strategy aligned to Lonza’s enterprise goals
• Act as global functional owner for Finance services with clear governance, KPIs, and accountability
• Partner with the Lonza Capability Centre to align service delivery capabilities and infrastructure
• Ensure high‑quality, efficient global delivery across O2C, S2P, R2R, FLER, SAR, and Finance CoE
• Drive global standardization, simplification, and continuous performance improvement

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein/e Laborant/in der QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. Als Mitglied unseres jungen und dynamischen Mikrobiologie-Teams, bist du unter Einhaltung der GMP- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien verantwortliche für die Routine-Durchführung von verschiedenen mikrobiologischen Methoden. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Durchführung analytischer Methoden im Aufgabenbereich, Auswertung, Review und Berichten der Ergebnisse.
• Erstellen von Analysenprotokollen, Prüfanweisungen und Kurzberichten.
• Dokumentation aller Labortätigkeiten entsprechend GMP und internen Richtlinien.
• Einhaltung der Qualitäts- (SOP und GMP) und der Sicherheitsvorschriften.
• Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor.
• Methodischer Hauptfokus: Keim Identifizierungen und Endotoxin Messungen. Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Laborant/in, BTA, oder BSC mit Fachrichtung Biologie, Biochemie oder ähnlichem Bereich.
• Fliessend Deutsch und English von Vorteil.
• Hands-on Labor Erfahrung (insbesondere Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Analysetechniken) sind ein Plus.
• Kenntnisse im Bereich GMP ist ein Plus . Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Der Anlagemeister – Support Infra gewährleistet durch eine intensive Betreuung seiner ihm zugeteilten Anlagen und Prozesse (Reinstmedien und HVAC) ein nach GMP - Richtlinien funktionsfähiges Produktionsumfeld. Dabei unterstützt er die Projektteams im PCP / PCPSS, welche für die Herstellung von Bioconjugaten verantwortlich sind. Die Hauptfunktion beinhaltet die Bedienung sowie die korrekte Instandhaltung der Clean-Steam, Purified Water, Water for injection, HeatingVentilation & Air Conditioning Systems HVAC, sowie das Erkennen und Beheben von Störungen der ihm zugeteilten Anlagen und Prozesse. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Sicherstellen das die Anlagen für Clean-Steam, Purified Water, Water for injection und Heating Ventilation & Air Conditioning Systems (HVAC), sowie alle Energie-Systeme laufend regelkonform den Betrieben PCP und PCPSS zur Verfügung stehen.
• Bearbeitung, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen des Umgebungs- und Wassermonitorings sowie dem Monitoring von Prozessgasen im PCP und PCPSS.
• Erstellung und Pflege der notwendigen SOPs für den zugeteilten Bereich
• Unterstützt Fremdfirmen bei Arbeiten in den Betriebsgebäuden und erteilt Arbeitsbewilligungen in seinem zugeteilten Verantwortungsbereich.
• Stellt sicher, dass alle Kühlgeräte und Kühlräume im PCP und PCPSS laufend und regelkonform zur Verfügung stehen
• Vertretung der zugeteilten Bereiche an Behörden- und Kundenaudits
• die Sicherstellung, dass die ihm zugeteilten Systemen/Apparate kontinuierlich und regelkonform betrieben werden.
• die Gewährleistung von funktionsfähigen Systeme/Apparate für die Produktion durch regelmässige Kontrollen und Wartungen.
• die anlagentechnische Schulung/Ausbildung der Operatoren in seinem Aufgabenbereich.
• Sorgt für Sauberkeit und Ordnung in der Anlage und Utilitybereich
• die Unterstützung des AM Supports im Bereich Betriebshygiene PCP Was wir suchen:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemie- und Pharmatechnologe (Chemikant) oder Laborant Fachrichtung Chemie/Biologie oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich GMP Produktion oder Reinstmedien oder im Utility Bereich

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of The Visp site in Switzerland is growing rapidly, driven by our Advanced Synthesis Business Platform, which includes Bioconjugates and Small Molecules. Our teams specialize in developing and manufacturing drug substances under GMP, helping bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide. We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Advanced Synthesis organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below:
• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness.
• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.
• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.
• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.
• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.
• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.
• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development. What we are looking for:
• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.
• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.
• Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and organizational factors.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex programs.
• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing and drug substance development.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
• Fluent in English; German is a plus. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Join our Engineering team and help shape the future of performance, reliability, and sustainability at our Visp site. In this role as Reliability & Performance Manager 80-100% (m/f/d), you will drive the definition and tracking of Engineering KPIs across all sub‑groups, evaluate maintenance and CQV activities to optimize cost and performance, and assess CAPEX effectiveness. You will also take ownership of sustainability initiatives by defining goals, KPIs, and projects, while acting as the key interface to our global sustainability program. What you’ll get: • An agile career and dynamic working culture • An inclusive and ethical workplace • Compensation programs that recognize high performance • In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you’ll do: Reliability & Performance Management • Define, implement, and continuously improve Engineering KPIs across all groups (Maintenance / Plant Engineering, CQV, EI&C, Utilities, Projects). • Perform systematic bad actor analysis (equipment, systems, processes) using failure data, maintenance history, deviations, and cost drivers. Lessons Learned for projects. • Evaluate maintenance strategies and execution (preventive vs. corrective vs. runtime, backlog, cost structures) and identify optimization potential to reduce total OPEX cost. • Review CQV activities and lifecycle performance, ensuring cost‑effective execution while maintaining GMP and quality compliance. • Analyze asset performance data and translate findings into actionable improvement measures and standards. CAPEX Performance & Governance • Evaluate CAPEX performance for Engineering projects (cost, schedule, reliability impact). • Identify recurring weaknesses and improvement levers across the project lifecycle (design, execution, handover, early operation). • Support Engineering leadership with data‑driven insights for CAPEX prioritization, lessons learned, and performance reviews. Sustainability • Define sustainability‑related goals, KPIs, and Engineering projects in alignment with INB and site strategy. • Act as local Engineering interface to the global sustainability program, including reporting, alignment, and contribution to global initiatives. • Identify and drive Engineering‑led sustainability improvements (energy, water, utilities, asset efficiency, lifecycle optimization). Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement • Establish transparent KPI dashboards and reporting routines for Engineering leadership. • Drive standardization, best practices, and continuous improvement across Engineering processes. • Act as a sparring partner for Engineering managers on performance, cost efficiency, and reliability topics. What we are looking for: • Bachelor’s degree (BSc) in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automation Engineering; MSc preferred. • 5–10 years of advanced professional experience in Engineering, Operations, or CAPEX project environments. • Strong technical understanding with experience in Engineering, Operations, or CAPEX projects. • Proven project experience and the ability to evaluate technical data and performance metrics. • Solid analytical and evaluation skills, including the ability to interpret complex engineering information. • Proficiency in SAP for maintenance, project, or asset‑related processes. • Business‑fluent English (required) and German (preferred). About Lonza: At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Lehrstelle Laborant/in EFZ Biologie per 1. August 2026 (m/f/d) Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Lonza in Basel bietet eine spannende Ausbildung als Laborant/in EFZ Fachrichtung Biologie an. In dieser dreijährigen Lehre spezialisierst du dich auf die Bioanalytik und arbeitest an der Entwicklung und Durchführung moderner biologischer Tests. Die Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch, wodurch du die Möglichkeit hast, deine Sprachkenntnisse täglich einzusetzen und kontinuierlich zu erweitern. Du bist Teil eines motivierten Teams, führst Versuche durch, wertest Ergebnisse aus und dokumentierst diese präzise. Während deiner Ausbildung bei Lonza arbeitest du mit modernsten Geräten, sensiblen Messinstrumenten und Software, aber auch mit klassischen Labormethoden wie Pipette und Waage. Die theoretische Ausbildung findet an der Berufsschule in Muttenz (BL) statt. Dort erlernst du alle grundlegenden Kenntnisse in den jeweiligen Fachgebieten. Ergänzt wird die Ausbildung durch überbetriebliche Kurse (üK), in denen du zusätzliche praktische Fähigkeiten erwirbst. Deine Aufgaben: • Entwicklung und Durchführung von Versuchen (Immunologie und Biotechnologie) • Arbeiten mit Zellkulturen und Durchführung enzymatischer Tests • Versuche nach Anleitung durchführen und Ergebnisse auswerten • Sorgfältige und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Arbeitsschritten und Resultaten • Unterstützung bei der Etablierung neuer Methoden für Qualitätskontrolle und Projekte • Zusammenarbeit in Projektgruppen in einem internationalen Umfeld Dein Anforderungsprofil: • Schulabschluss auf mittlerem oder oberem Niveau oder Matura/Abitur • Faszination für naturwissenschaftliche Vorgänge und biologische Systeme • Strukturierte und logische Denkweise • Exaktes und sauberes Arbeiten • Gute Beobachtungsgabe • Interesse an modernen Labortechniken und neuen Technologien • Freude an Teamarbeit • Englischkenntnisse (Im Lesen und Verstehen von Fachtexten/ mündlich) Benefits für Lernende: • 6 Wochen Ferien und zusätzlich bezahlte Feiertage • Generalabonnement (GA) für CHF 1.- pro Tag • Persönliches IT-Equipment • Lunch-Check ist ein Verpflegungs-Benefit, mit dem man vergünstigt oder kostenlos Mahlzeiten bezahlen können • E-Bikes für private und geschäftliche Fahrten • Kostenlosen, unbegrenzten Zugang zu Online-Lernplattformen und Sprachkursen Du interessierst dich für unsere Lehrstelle und willst Teil von Lonza werden? Dann freuen wir uns über deine Online-Bewerbung über unser Recruiting-Tool mit folgenden Unterlagen: • Zeugnisse der letzten drei Schuljahre (Sekundarschule) • Lebenslauf mit Foto • Motivationsschreiben Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich. Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Based in Basel with the flexibility to travel as required, this role offers a seasoned IT professional the chance to provide world-class, personalized technical support to Lonza’s executive leadership and VIPs. You will be the face of IT for our highest-level stakeholders, ensuring that their technology is seamless, secure, and always optimized in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment. The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. What you will get: • An agile career and a dynamic work culture. • An inclusive and ethical workplace. • Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. • Benefits in Basel: https://bit.ly/3HZNGv2 What you will do: • Provide expert on-site and remote technical assistance, resolving hardware, software, and network issues with the highest level of professionalism and urgency. • Manage a specialized suite of mobile devices, laptops, and collaboration tools, ensuring secure VPN access and seamless communication for VIPs globally. • Take full ownership of AV and IT systems for board-level meetings and executive presentations, serving as the primary technical point of contact on-site. • Perform regular "health checks" on VIP equipment and environments to prevent downtime before it occurs, staying ahead of potential outages. • Build deep, professional relationships with executives to understand their unique technical preferences and provide personalized IT training to enhance their productivity. • Handle sensitive data and high-level interactions with absolute discretion, ensuring all support activities strictly adhere to global IT security policies. • Work closely with specialized IT teams and leadership to escalate complex issues and implement software updates with zero disruption to executive workflows. What we are looking for: • 3-5 years of experience in IT or Business Services, with a proven track record specifically in high-touch VIP or Executive support. • Advanced troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and networking, including mobile device management and secure meeting room technologies. • Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to remain calm, composed, and discreet under extreme pressure from high-profile stakeholders. • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Management (or equivalent experience) and ITIL certification are required to ensure alignment with global service standards. • Business fluency in English is essential; fluency in German is highly preferred to support our stakeholders in Basel and beyond. • A logical thinker who can translate complex technical information into simple, actionable advice for non-technical users. • Flexibility to travel to residential or remote offices as needed and the agility to embrace change within a global corporate structure. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Location, Visp, Switzerland. Starte deine Karriere als Praktikant/in im Trainingsteam der LP/SSP - Small Molecules (m/w/d) in der pharmazeutischen Industrie – unterstütze unser Team für 6-12 Monate in Visp beim Aufarbeiten und der Optimierung von Schulungsmaterialien. Spannende und detailreiche Einblicke in den chemischen Betrieb, moderne Technologien und echte Verantwortung warten auf dich! Ihre Aufgaben: • Beschaffen und Bearbeiten von schulungsrelevanten Informationen und Hilfsmitteln in Bezug auf betriebliche Prozesse. • Selbstständige Ausarbeitung von Schulungsunterlagen und Arbeitsanweisungen für den Betrieb. • Aktualisieren und Überprüfen von Schulungsdokumenten. • Mitarbeit an der Umsetzung des Trainingskonzepts für Operatoren und der Dokumentation von Trainingserfolgen. Was wir suchen: • Abgeschlossene chemische oder pharmatechnologische Berufsausbildung. (Eidgenössisches Fachzeugnis EFZ). Von Vorteil: Bachelor-Abschluss (Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen), Fachhochschulstudium (FH)/ Technikerschule (HF) oder ähnliches. • Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten, ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit. • Strukturiertes, fokussiertes und sehr gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten. • Interesse an chemischen Produktionsprozessen. • Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse. Über Lonza: Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Am Standort Visp wird ein QC Data Reviewer (m/w/d) für die QC Mikrobiologie gesucht. In dieser Position überprüfen Sie die Protokolle der Laboranten auf gute Dokumentationspraxis. Ausserdem sind Sie für die Identifizierung und Behebung von Fehlerquellen der Arbeitsroutinen verantwortlich. Da wir uns in einem kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess des Labors befinden, wird proaktive Mitarbeit und das Einbringen von eigenen mehr als wertgeschätzt. Ihre Aufgaben: • Sorgfältige Überprüfung von Analyseprotokolle. • Selbstständige Prüfung der Dokumentation und der Endergebnisse. • Enge Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit dem Laborteam, Wissenschaftler*innen und Projektleiter*innen. • Regelmässige Mitarbeiterschulungen zur Beseitigung von Fehlerquellen und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Zusammenarbeit. • Aktive Beteiligung an der Laborplanung und Mitentwicklung von Verbesserungsprozessen. Ihr Anforderungsprofil: • Hochschulabschluss (FH/BSc/ MSc) oder mehrjährige Laborerfahrung. • GMP-Erfahrung von Vorteil, ist aber keine Voraussetzung. • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit LIMS wünschenswert. • Ein Hohes Mass an Selbstorganisation. • Eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie Freude an der Arbeit in einem jungen, motivierten Team. • Kommunikationsstärke und fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen, ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Hybrid Work Model is applicable. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. For our site in Visp we are currently looking for a Senior Quality Excellence Manager (m/f/d), who will become part of our Quality Excellence team. In this role, you will drive operational excellence at its best and contribute as a strong influential LEAN specialist within a matrix organization to support our Quality organization on its way to best in class performance. What you will get: • An agile career and dynamic working culture • An inclusive and ethical workplace • Compensation programs that recognize high performance • A variety of benefits dependant on role and location The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. What you will do: • Drive process standardization and efficiency in line with Lonza’s LBMS standards • Support the implementation of a Lean Batch Release program on site • Establish Quality Excellence CoE and PMO structures, supporting the standardization, simplification and digitalization of our key quality processes • Facilitate to embed a LEAN culture of continuous improvement and ideation within Quality • Monitor and enable reporting of Quality performance KPIs for our site in Visp and initiate necessary activities to enable target achievement by the departments in scope • Support multi-disciplinary project teams and hold team members accountable to achieve the project goals within given timelines • Share best practice within the Visp Site as well as with the wider Lonza Pharma network What we are looking for: • University Degree in a scientific area OR an absolved apprenticeship in a pharmaceutical environment (e.g. Lab Technician, CPT, etc) • Profound experience in a GMP regulated environment; preferably within QA/QC • Experience with Lean / Six Sigma, within a Quality related environment • Certified Green Belt or higher is required • PowerBI and/or Minitab knowledge would be an advantage • Fluent German (written and verbal) and good English language skills are required • Strong ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different functions About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a dedicated MES Drug Expert to join our team in Visp, Switzerland. If you're passionate about applying your expertise to optimize drug product manufacturing and truly make a difference, we encourage you to explore this opportunity. What you will do: • Author and adapt MES/PCS Recipe based on the Drug Product Processes. • Responsible for defining the overall concept for MES recipes used in Drug Product Operations Visp to ensure an easy and fast creation as well as adaption. • Build and maintain relevant GMP documents (IQ, OQ, PQ etc.) • Provide front line MES support, working with the manufacturing teams (operators), plant engineers and QA operations. • Provide MES training for all end user. • Act as Subject Matter Expert during customer audits and visits, maintain MES at inspection readiness level and provides support where needed. • ​Lead process related investigations and critical deviations and assists in decision making on production issues. • Lead process changes, CAPAs, and CAPA efficiency checks related to process within required timelines and through GMP systems (e.g. Trackwise, MES, training, etc.) • ​Implements innovation and improvement projects comprising general manufacturing aspects for the production plant. What we are looking for: • Studies in Pharmaceutical Technology/ Chemistry/ Pharmacy. • Experience in MES recipe authoring, preferably in Emerson Syncade. • Process knowledge in the area of sterile drug product is advantageous. • Knowledge of DeltaV is preferable. • Familiar with working in regulated environment, knowledge of cGMP, 21CRF part 11 and validation requirements. • Proficient in both German and English is an asset. • Familiarity with GMP requirements, quality procedures and SOP execution. • Good interpersonal skills and interaction with a variety of interfaces within the organization and on the shopfloor. • Structured, focused and well-organized working demeanor. • Motivated and driven; with a problem-solving attitude. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.en: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Based in Visp , Switzerland, this role operates at the interface of Operations, Engineering and Strategic Growth Projects within the Advanced Synthesis network. In close collaboration with Global Engineering, MSAT, Quality and Strategy teams, the Associate Director, Asset Design and Innovation leads the development, evaluation and implementation of state-of-the-art and future-oriented asset and technology solutions with focus on growth-projects. This role is ideal for a self‑driven individual who proactively identifies opportunities to improve asset design, manufacturing performance and technology deployment. The position has a strong focus on enabling highly cost‑effective, compliant and reliable manufacturing by design, with particular emphasis on optimized lifecycle and OpEx performance. Beyond individual projects, the role actively shapes a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and innovation across the global network and may take key responsibilities in selected global strategic growth initiatives. What you will get: • An agile career and a dynamic work culture. • An inclusive and ethical workplace. • Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. • Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do: • Proactively identify, evaluate and drive opportunities to improve asset design and manufacturing technologies, delivering measurable gains in cost, reliability and performance. • Take full end-to-end ownership for innovation initiatives in growth projects – from idea generation and feasibility assessment through business case development, implementation oversight and benefit realization. • Independently evaluate, propose and justify solutions that optimize operational expenditure (OpEx) and asset lifecycle costs by design. • Actively integrate forward-looking, fit-for-purpose solutions into strategic growth projects while ensuring full cGMP compliance and adherence to safety standards. • Continuously challenge the status quo, share best practices and actively contribute to building a sustainable manufacturing innovation platform across the Advanced Synthesis network. • Support and constructively challenge by proactively contributing ideas, insights and execution power to strategic transformation initiatives. What we are looking for: • Master’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biologics, or a related scientific discipline. • Senior-level, self-driven leader with a proven track record of identifying opportunities and converting them into sustainable operational and business impact. • Demonstrated ability to independently set direction, take full ownership and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion in a global matrix environment. • Deep manufacturing, engineering and technology expertise, combined with the confidence to challenge the status quo and influence senior stakeholders. • Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to build, defend and execute robust business cases while delivering against demanding performance targets. • Acts as a role model for accountability, execution excellence and continuous improvement, leading through actions rather than formal authority. • Innovative mindset with the ability to think beyond traditional boundaries; experience with Lonza systems and processes is a plus. • Excellent communication and influencing skills, enabling alignment and momentum across functions and leadership levels. • Fluent in English; German proficiency is a plus. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. descriptionByLocale.it: Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. Currently we are looking for Senior QA Specialists, who will work on our new growth project Vibe-X. As a member of a CAPEX projects Quality Project team, you will manage the QA related activities in close contact with QC, Engineering and Manufacturing to ensure the quality oversight is given. You will ensure timely delivery of project, even in the face of project requirements and priorities through excellent planning and management of the project. Join Lonza and apply for this innovative opportunity! Key responsibilities: • Responsible for project specific QA Operation work during commissioning/qualification and project tech transfer in IBEX • Assess and manage tasks that would impact Quality operation during GMP manufacturing • Plan for future activities and coordinate with other departments (e.g. QC, Engineering, Manufacturing) to complete the planned activities • Support day-to-day Quality Assurance activities in accordance with approved SOPs/Policies for a GMP manufacturing facility • Review GMP records to ensure compliance with cGMP per written procedures • Make real-time decisions on process events on the floor, based on knowledge of defined SOPs & policies • Participate in walkthroughs and audit/inspections Key requirements: • Bachelor of Science in Life Science or a related field • Significant experience in the pharmaceutical quality area • Work experience in a role in Quality Assurance, Production or Engineering, in pharmaceutical industries and cGMP controlled environment. QA experience in tech transfer is preferred • Excellent knowledge of computer systems (e.g. TW, SAP, etc.) and quality tools such as risk based approaches (e.g. FMEA) • Fluency in English Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Lonza è leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, che opera in tre continenti. Siamo attivi nella scienza, ma non ci sono formule magiche per come lavoriamo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante sono dipendenti di talento che lavorano insieme e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti gestiscono la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo condividere. ## Mansioni • Attuazione delle tarature, riqualificazione (PM/PV) e manutenzione delle apparecchiature di laboratorio nel campo del controllo della qualità secondo le specifiche SOP e del produttore. • risoluzione dei problemi, diagnosi e risoluzione dei problemi di apparecchiature di laboratorio complesse per garantire tempi di fermo minimi. • Responsabile della documentazione di tutti i lavori e dei risultati effettuati secondo le linee guida GMP e gli standard di qualità interna. • Lavorare con l'introduzione e la convalida di nuove apparecchiature e tecnologie di laboratorio. • Formazione dei dipendenti nella gestione di attrezzature di laboratorio e la loro corretta manutenzione. • Supporto per controlli interni ed esterni nel campo della qualificazione e della manutenzione del dispositivo. • Assicurare il rispetto di tutte le normative in materia di sicurezza e ambiente. • Gestione di pezzi di ricambio e materiali di consumo per apparecchiature di laboratorio. * Requisiti • Formazione tecnica completa (ad esempio come laboratorio chimico, laboratorio di biologia, laboratorio di fisica, CTA, BTA, PTA) o studi nel campo dell'ingegneria, scienze naturali o una disciplina comparabile. • Esperienza professionale pluriennale nella gestione dei dispositivi di laboratorio, calibrazione e qualificazione in un ambiente regolamentato (idealmente GMP). • Ricerca di conoscenze nella gestione di una varietà di apparecchiature di laboratorio (ad esempio HPLC, GC, spettrofotometro, titratori, ecc.). • Esperienza nella risoluzione dei problemi e nella risoluzione dei problemi dei sistemi di analisi complessi. • Buona conoscenza degli standard di qualità rilevanti (ad esempio GMP, GLP) e delle linee guida. • Gestione sicura delle applicazioni MS Office. • Lingua tedesca e capacità di scrittura; buone abilità inglesi sono di vantaggio. • Capacità di problem solving goffrate, orientamento dettagliato e lavoro indipendente. • Competenze di squadra, forza di comunicazione e un alto orientamento di servizio. I prodotti e i servizi di Cosa# offrono un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza viene dato rispetto e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente ragionevole. A Lonza, le persone che affrontano le sfide e sviluppano nuove idee per problemi complessi con la loro creatività nell'area della Life Science vengono a Lonza. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo dà loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro. ## Contatto Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de: Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Als Betriebs-/Anlagetechniker (m/w/d) sind Sie zuständig für die technische und logistische Abwicklung von Produktionskampagnen in einem Produktionsbetrieb zur Herstellung von Biokonjugaten. Sie sind Mitglied eines interdisziplinären Teams und arbeiten in Projektteams mit, welche sich um Investitionen sowie Optimierungen von Abläufen, Tätigkeiten und Systemen kümmern. Was auf Sie wartet: • Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur. • Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld. • Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben: • Einbringung in Planungs- und Engineering Phase von Projekten, um technische Vorgaben für die Anlagen einzuhalten und eine erfolgreiche Produktionskampagne sicherzustellen • Organisatorische und betriebstechnische Betreuung, sowie Überwachung der Produktionskampagnen, zur Sicherstellung der Produktion und Sicherheit auch ausserhalb der normalen Arbeitszeit • Erstellung von cGMP gerechter Dokumentation in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Anlageteamleiter, der Forschung/Entwicklung und den Betriebsbiotechnologen • Anlagetechnische Instruktion und produktionsspezifische Ausbildung der Operatoren während der Produktion • Kontrolle der lückenlosen Befolgung der Betriebsvorschriften und Herstellungsprotokolle, sowie Eingriff bei Abweichungen • Unterstützung des Informationsaustausches und Kommunikation innerhalb der Betriebsgruppe • Durchgehende Verbesserung von Anlagen, Abläufen und Prozessen (6S, Lean Six Sigma, KAIZEN) unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Hygiene-, Umwelt- und Qualitätsanforderungen Was wir suchen: • Abgeschlossene technische Aus- oder Weiterbildung (Berufslehre, Höhere Fachprüfung, Bachelor, Master) • Vorteilhaft wäre Produktionserfahrung bei der Herstellung von chemischen oder biotechnologischen Produkten, oder in der Lebensmittelindustrie • Idealerweise erste Erfahrung im ISO- und / oder GMP-Produktionsumfeld • Sie verfügen über Grundkenntnisse in MS Office (Excel, Word) und sind affin für elektronische Systeme und Anwendungen • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sowie Englischkenntnisse • Bereitschaft zur Leistung von Pikettdienst muss vorhanden sein Wir bieten attraktive Benefits sowie ein umfassendes Relocation-Paket für talentierte neue Mitarbeitende. Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

What you will do:

• Independent operation and execution of upstream related activities according to specified instructions (manufacturing protocols / operating instructions / work instructions / SOP)

• Safe and correct execution of work in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account the cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order at the workplace as well as the assigned rooms and storage areas

• Performing monitoring, maintenance, and cleaning tasks, as well as reporting and rectifying defects and malfunctions in the facility, including their documentation

• Every employee is involved as an equal team member through their active participation in continuous improvement processes

What we are looking for:

• Completed professional training (Apprenticeship)

• Chemical or pharmaceutical-technical training as well as GMP and/or BICO training advantageous

• Good skills in speaking, writing, and comprehension in German or English required.

• Accurate work and documentation practices

• Execution of tasks with a high level of safety and quality awareness

• Willingness to work shifts (4-shift operation) with flexibility in work scheduling

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Location. Visp. Rilocalizzazione, supportato. Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. # Cosa # Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica. • Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico. • Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni. • Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione. L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile anche su https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. ## Mansioni • Eseguire la produzione end-to-end di prodotti farmaceutici sotto GMP: esecuzione in batch, documentazione, risoluzione dei problemi e revisione dei risultati. • Completare e mantenere tutta la documentazione GMP (batch records, logbook, form). Maintenir une culture d'autonomisation et d'innovation, de confiance, de haute performance et de préparation au changement. • Prise en charge du système technique: fournir un leadership scientifique à l'équipe et à d'autres fonctions pour s'assurer que les processus d'inspection visuelle sont exécutés en temps voulu, de manière rentable et de la plus haute qualité. Prévoir, évaluer et résoudre les défis techniques de manière proactive et permettre l'innovation. • Responsable de la prise en charge opérationnelle de l'inspection visuelle manuelle automatisée, semi-automatisée et des essais d'intégrité de la fermeture des conteneurs • Gérer l'interface client dans les visites techniques du client et adapter les capacités techniques afin de répondre aux exigences du client. Représenter l'établissement pendant les inspections réglementaires et les vérifications des clients et des autorités sanitaires. • Responsable de la sécurité, de la conformité et des aspects réglementaires. Préparation d'une analyse des risques et de toutes les procédures pertinentes pour assurer la conformité à la réglementation et atteindre les objectifs opérationnels. • Soutien de l'équipe du projet sur des sujets complexes par l'utilisation des connaissances scientifiques et statistiques. • Assurer et gérer les interfaces entre l'équipe CAPEX, Manufacturing, Plant Engineering, Automation, Support, QC et QA. Collaborer avec les fonctions du projet et de l'ensemble des Services des produits pharmaceutiques, en particulier les installations existantes des produits pharmaceutiques. • Appuyer le directeur principal responsable opérationnel de l'un de nos plus grands projets de croissance (Dauphin) dans l'élaboration, la hiérarchisation et l'atteinte des objectifs du projet et des objectifs généraux du DPS (Drug Product Services). Assurer un bon échange d'information entre la direction et l'organisation, et ce, par le biais de réunions d'équipe régulières et de communications claires. ## Requisiti • Une vaste expérience dans l'inspection visuelle du produit pharmaceutique parentéral (en particulier les flacons et les seringues) dans un environnement BPF est un must. Une vaste expérience avec différents systèmes d'inspection visuelle tels que manuel, semi-automatique ou AVI est un avantage. • L'expérience en leadership d'équipe est une condition préalable • Expérience avec les audits des autorités sanitaires • La maîtrise de l'anglais est un must (la maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage) avec de solides compétences en communication avec les parties prenantes de différents niveaux et fonctions. À propos de Lonza Chez Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

descriptionByLocale.en: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. In this role, you will contribute to robust monitoring activities by evaluating complex data, improving processes, and supporting compliance in a GMP‑regulated environment. You will work closely with cross‑functional partners and play an active role in inspections and continuous improvement initiatives. What you will get: • An agile scientific career in a dynamic, GMP‑regulated environment. • An inclusive and ethical workplace that values collaboration and accountability. • Compensation programs that recognize performance and technical expertise. • Opportunities to deepen your expertise and take ownership of impactful projects. • Exposure to cross‑functional collaboration and regulatory interactions. • A supportive culture that encourages continuous improvement and learning. • Competitive local benefits. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do: • You collect, evaluate, and summarize monitoring data using MODA, LIMS, and digital analysis tools. • You document GMP‑relevant activities and lead investigations of alert or action level excursions. • You drive root‑cause investigations and align corrective actions with key stakeholders. • You create, review, and approve DMS documents to ensure accuracy and compliance. • You improve monitoring processes to enhance data quality, efficiency, and robustness. • You implement monitoring updates and manage MODA‑related changes under change control. • You represent the team during inspections, audits, and customer visits with confidence. What we are looking for: • You hold a degree in life sciences or a related scientific field. • You bring around two years of relevant experience in a GMP‑regulated environment. • Experience in environmental monitoring and/or microbiology is an advantage. • You have strong digital skills, including Microsoft Office and documentation systems. • Knowledge of regulatory requirements, pharmacopoeias, and EU Annex 1 is ideal but not required. • You communicate confidently in English; German skills are a plus. • You work independently and bring a proactive, detail‑oriented, solution‑focused mindset. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. descriptionByLocale.de: Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf der fachlichen und GMP-konformen Prüfung von Labor- und analytischen Daten sowie der Sicherstellung der regulatorischen Compliance. Ihr Anforderungsprofil: • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch von Vorteil. • Labor-Ausbildung, naturwissenschaftlicher Bachelor oder relevante Berufserfahrung. • Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld wünschenswert. • Sorgfältige, präzise und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise. • Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit. • Lernbereitschaft und Weiterentwicklungswunsch. Was Sie auszeichnet: • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Integrität. • Sachliche Herangehensweise bei Abweichungen und Fehlern. • Freude an Zusammenarbeit, Organisation und klaren Prozessen. Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a DeltaV Automation Engineer or Electrical Instrumentation & Control Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in a dynamic, cutting-edge environment where your work will significantly contribute to shaping the future of medicine.

## Cosa offriamo
• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

• The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

## Mansioni
• Planning and realization of electrical MSR readiness (maintenance, changeovers, improvements) within the available budget and timelines

• Ensuring seamless operation and flawless performance of high-automated Biologics facilities equipped with DeltaV and MES systems. Equivalent experience is also acceptable for educational requirements like MES

• Managing GMP-compliant activities, including testing, documentation, and change management using systems such as Kneat and Ubik

• Preparing and updating plant documentation in SAP/COMOS to ensure strict compliance with regulatory standards

• Determining and implementing continuous improvements in equipment and maintenance processes to improve efficiency and reliability

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine internal procedures and achieve optimized workflows

## Requisiti
• Equivalent experience in Electrical or System Engineering or a related field, including University Degree or equivalent experience, or vocational education (EFZ, FH, HF, BSc.)

• Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of pharmaceutical plants or the biotech industry

• Proficiency in SAP, COMOS (Plant Engineering Software), DeltaV (Process Control System), and MES Syncade (Manufacturing Execution System) is highly desirable

• Proficient in English and/or German to competently communicate in our diverse, collaborative environment

• Familiarity with GMP standards and protocols to ensure compliance in a regulated manufacturing setting

• A self-reliant, trustworthy, and effective working approach that ensures successful completion of tasks and projects

## Contatto
Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
